original_ai_output.title_zh: 刚果（金）伊图里省布尼亚启动新型埃博拉疫苗临床试验
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 刚果（金）伊图里省布尼亚于周六启动一项新型埃博拉疫苗临床试验，名为TUMAiNi的试验将评估针对本迪布焦型埃博拉病毒的候选疫苗，对象为确诊病例的接触者。伊图里省省长称试验启动是抗击疫情的重要时刻。该国正努力控制其历史上最致命、扩散最快的埃博拉疫情。

location.raw_text: Bunia, in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri Province

key_facts.fact: 刚果（金）伊图里省布尼亚启动新型埃博拉疫苗临床试验
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A clinical trial for a new Ebola vaccine launched in Bunia, in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri Province, on Saturday

key_facts.fact: TUMAiNi试验将评估针对本迪布焦型埃博拉病毒的候选疫苗，对象为确诊病例的接触者
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The TUMAiNi trial will evaluate candidate vaccines against Ebola caused by the Bundibugyo virus among contacts of confirmed cases.

key_facts.fact: 刚果（金）正努力控制其历史上最致命、扩散最快的埃博拉疫情
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: as the country struggles to contain the deadliest and fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in its history

key_facts.fact: 伊图里省省长称试验启动是抗击疫情的重要时刻
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Major General Kasongo Gaby, governor of Ituri Province said the launch of the trial marked a significant moment in the fight against the outbreak.
